description: A wrapping daypart whose days_of_week names only the phantom weekday 9 is refused DAYPART_DAYS_INVALID at authoring time. This is the shape that fails OPEN if stored: DAT-073's wrap expansion places the post-midnight tail on (day + 1) mod 7 -- for 9 that is 3, a real Wednesday -- so the row's head matches nothing while its tail lands real coverage on a real weekday the author never named. The write gate is where such a row becomes impossible; the runtime additionally expands an out-of-range member to no coverage at all.

dayparts.name: Overnight On A Day That Does Not Exist
